Chapter 6558: Too High Of A Price

Chapter 6558: Too High Of A Price

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost was furious due to his current status in Three Immortals. It was one thing for an immortal to do it but the guy was a supreme overlord just like him.

Nevertheless, he took a deep breath and calmed his rage.

“Dao Brother, you are being unreasonable here. This is more than just a robbery...” He spoke.

“Luminous, I am not here to negotiate. I demand a debt repayment and that is final.” Xian Chengtian interrupted him, still looking transcendent despite acting as a loan shark.

“You are unreasonable, the source was born from my mind and is a part of me. You are asking for my life, not a debt repayment.” He shook his head, still able to restrain himself.

“Is that so?” Chengtian sneered: “You didn’t cherish it back then and wanted to sever it. Now, it’s inseparable?”

“Circumstances changed.” He said: “Please reconsider, your starting price is too high.”

The source might be the key to his immortal ascension. How could he give it up?

He wanted to sever it back then in order to escape the control of Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation.

These desires have been purified over the years and have become pure. The powers within were immense and most importantly, they came from the two redemption grounds.

“Too high? You didn’t have this tone when you sought me out after massacring your sect and leaving Old World. You offered everything so that I would stabilize your heart devil, let you join Supreme Heaven, and introduce you to Bao Pu. Would you be Primal Yin Immortal Ghost right now without my assistance?” Chengtian said, leaving the opponent speechless.

Chengtian did not hold back and revealed his unsavory past. During their era, Chengtian was the strongest beneath the immortal realm despite being far younger than him.

He only became an overlord with the help of the redemption grounds. Nevertheless, he still couldn’t compare to the heaven’s favorite. Xian Chengtian still decided to help and recommended him to Supreme Heaven. Once he got there, he was able to receive guidance from Zhan Sansheng.

Chengtian didn’t stop helping and introduced him to the mysterious Bao Pu. Few in Three Immortals had the same connection as Chengtian.

Therefore, Chengtian played a large part in Primal Yin Immortal Ghost’s success, hence an alliance known as Trinity Pact between them.

“You are crossing the line, Brother.” The ghost said.

He was no longer the same as before after absorbing his desires and the powers from the redemption grounds. He no longer feared Xian Chengtian.

“Oh?” Chengtian glared at him.

“I respect you and have always yielded.” He said: “But this doesn’t mean I am afraid of you when you are actively provoking me.”

“Looks like your spine is harder after absorbing that power.” Chengtian smirked.

“The dao stems from courage.” He said: “I didn’t have the same fortune as you, pampered by your masters and gifted numerous treasures. I suppose I should feel honored that despite your riches, you are still targeting my source of desires. Don’t tell me you’ve squandered them all?”

“You’re right, I’ve used up nearly all the good ones so that’s why I am here to get your source.” Chengtian understood the sarcasm.

“I see, you’re out of options. I fear that even if those three ancient immortals weren’t stabbed in the back by you, they’d have died of anger after seeing your incompetence."
